set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: Q03.1
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Institutional operator and service owner
Scope: Have an operator who did not implement the service follow the supported runbooks.

Work kind: institutional
Acceptance gate: Q03 (bd-01M4W40M7DJRQJWNCBEPR0AFEN)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Install and upgrade a packaged release, diagnose an injected operational fault and restore onto replacement infrastructure without the original host.
2. Include revocation and withdrawal after backup, current-session invalidation, retained-byte integrity and recovery of pending work.
3. Measure accepted RPO/RTO and document assistance or missing procedures; close only after runbook defects are fixed and affected steps repeated.
4. Use the institution’s declared independent physical failure domain with the original host unavailable; a same-workstation source-isolation rehearsal cannot substitute for the selected backup-medium and replacement-host proof.

Verification: Named operator walkthrough, artifact/configuration identities, raw recovery timings and exact access/export assertions.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/Q03.1/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

External inputs:
- Institutional operator
- Replacement host and independent backup sources

Source/contracts:
- docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md#5-what-qualification-must-prove
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md

Blocked by:
- O01: bd-01M4W40K19EDEPHZA7Y20F340Z
- O02: bd-01M4W40K6BGH2A78J8820FP8M6
- O04: bd-01M4W40KFJVWZAM6RZ8DDH4P2D
- F04.4: bd-01M4W5P6ARYGF29THMQHBFGDGF
- Q01: bd-01M4W40KZWFPTRA33A443C4DM8
- SITE01.3: bd-01M4W5P4DYBM03CDGZ6AGB9DVP

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: Q03.1: Rehearse install, upgrade and disaster recovery with an operator
